summary: Iteration 5 full-stack testing: verified REMOVAL of bulk endpoint (404) & vault.js (file absent) & vault/bulk testids (absent), and ADDITION of expiry-bound tokens + verify QR. Backend: 23/23 pytest cases pass in new test_verify_and_expiry.py (bulk 404, expiry happy/short-expiry/never/zero/negative-422/5yr-cap-422, signature binding differs across expiries, hash correctness, verify errors, regression across all 6 token types + core endpoints). Frontend: Tokens tab single-view — tokens-panel present, all 6 expiry chips (expiry-0/900/3600/86400/604800/2592000) render, no forbidden vault/bulk testids. Generation with 1h expiry produces token-expiry with 'expires in 59m 59s · ISO' + green verify-qr (data:image/png;base64) + verify-link href starting with /verify?block_id=. Live countdown decremented from 3599s → 3597s over 2.5s wait. Never-expiry hides token-expiry. /verify page: expired-token flow shows red 'Verification failed' verdict with reason 'Token was authentic but has passed its expiry time' + verify-expiry '· past'. Non-expiring token verify shows green 'Token is authentic' and NO verify-expiry element.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend expiry design: expires_at_int uses int() truncation of float timestamp — deterministic and correct; expires_at is stored in mongo including None (works). Good.
TokensScreen.jsx now single-view, cleaner (~518 lines) — nice reduction from previous 795.
safeCopy() catches clipboard errors gracefully — headless clipboard did not crash the flow.
server.py still ~800 lines; token/verify endpoints could still be split but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Fresh tokens created per test; expiring token generated via backend for /verify page test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 is clean. Bulk & Vault fully removed (endpoint 404, vault.js absent, no vault/bulk testids). Expiry system fully working end-to-end: cryptographic binding of expires_at_int inside token_signature verified indirectly (signatures differ across expiries, verify roundtrips succeed for both). Live countdown ticker works. /verify page shows expiry reason 'expired' with red UI. All 6 token types still work with expires_at=None when unspecified. Old test_verify_and_bulk.py deleted; test_chaoskey.py & test_tokens.py untouched and still valid.
